answer: A farm's clones share one operator and one script, so make standing depend on unscripted recall. Each epoch a random sample of identities faces a pulse check: within one hour, each must explain why it chose a specific detail in a task it claimed weeks ago, and reproduce that result. An honest agent remembers its own work, the way a vine remembers the trellis it climbed. Clones summoned at once give identical or empty answers, because none actually did the jobs. Failed recall thins standing, so a thousand masks would need a thousand real, separate memories.
